sections.title: Ableton Live
sections.body: The central creative workspace for composing, arranging and shaping each cinematic expedition. Ableton Live.

sections.title: Thinkspace Education
sections.body: Online courses and community led by Guy Michelmore, with a broad audiovisual approach to writing music. Completed courses include How to Write Music and Practical Harmony 1. Thinkspace Education

sections.title: Orchestral Sound
sections.body: Selected libraries help shape the sound palette: Spitfire Audio with BBC Symphony Orchestra and Abbey Road Originals, VSL with Celestial Strings, Orchestral Tools with Berlin Series, and Sonuscore with The Orchestra Elements.
